summary: OpenAI published a case study showing Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 financial documents, find four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in a document-review workflow.

practices.reason: The reported error-detection and performance-improvement figures come from a customer's own internal workflow test, not a transferable benchmark an engineering team could run.
practices.quote: Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 documents in minutes, find all four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in this financial-review workflow.
